newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tomen to be partner in huge Thai power project.
newsitem.headline: Tomen to be partner in huge Thai power project.

text.p: Japanese trading firm Tomen Corp said on Monday it would contribute 34 percent of the initial capital for a $1.2 billion joint-venture project involving a 1.4 million kilowatt coal-fired power plant in Thailand.

Other members of the three-party consortium are Finnish state-controlled power group Imatran Voima Oy (IVO), which will have a 15 percent interest, and Thailand's Saha Union Plc, which will have a 51 percent interest, a Tomen spokesman said.
Work on the Hin Krut power plant, some 300 km south of Bangkok, is due to begin later this year.
The electricity is due to be delivered to state-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) from 2001 on a 25-year contract, the spokesman said.
